motion: the water in the bowl ripples constantly with a faint trickling sound
the flapper lifts and a rush of water pours into the bowl
the blue tint spreads in the tank and slowly appears in the bowl water
the water level in the tank drops to the bottom
the old flapper is lifted off and the new one clicks onto the pegs
the incoming water stops when the float is pushed down
the water rises and stops right at the mark
the nut turns and the valve comes out of the tank
a thin sheet of water spills over the rim of the tube
the handle returns to rest with a soft click
the water refills quietly and stops with no further sound
